annotations.text:
The idea: removing a sound is striking a line through it.
Kept removals are struck out and greyed. Un-check one and the text stands back up — the sound comes back into the mix.
Strictly achromatic. Black and white do the work; two greys carry hierarchy. Selection on the waveform is an inverted band — white bars on black — rather than a colour.

This is the README diagram, not a picture of it — both artboards embed the exact SVG that ships.

GitHub picks one by prefers-color-scheme, so the same drawing reads on either theme. Both are generated by design/make_diagram.py; edit that, not the SVG.
